recentItems.description:

🎞️ Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom is in UK and US cinemas September 18 🎞️

Everyone is looking forward to Halloween on Mossy Bottom Farm - until the clumsy Farmer trashes the Flock’s beloved pumpkin patch! But when Shaun turns MAD SCIENTIST to fix the problem, things rapidly spiral out of control. With the Farmer missing and a wild beast roaming the woods of Mossingham, all the ingredients are in place for a monstrously fun family adventure.

recentItems.title: Shaun the Sheep S7 Full Episode | Gone to the Dogs | Aardman Animations
recentItems.description:
Bitzer's Dad comes to stay but isn't impressed with how Bitzer and Shaun run the flock.

Aardman favourite Shaun the Sheep is back making mischief on Mossy Bottom Farm in it's 7th series! Filled with hilarious, heart- warming comedy. Witness high-tension drama as Bitzer puts up a new shelf, the unexpected outcome of a stuck-in-the-mud tractor, the Farmer’s calamitous attempts at beekeeping, and Shaun and Bitzer getting competitive over camping. This series also features the first ever Shaun the Sheep two-part episode – A Christmas Carol-style fable where Shaun makes an impulsive wish… with unexpected consequences. 

Watch more Shaun the Sheep on Shaun's Global Official channel: https://www.youtube.com/@ShauntheSheepOfficial

For viewers in the UK, you can find more full episodes on BBC iPlayer: https://www.bbc.co.uk/iplayer/episodes/b006z39g/shaun-the-sheep

Romesh explains the story, shows off his character Nick, and then spends the rest of the mission insisting she’s not helping at all. Will this mother–son duo pull off the perfect eggscape?

recentItems.title: NEW🐑The Knit Before Christmas🐑Help Shaun the Sheep support Save the Children’s Christmas Jumper Day!
recentItems.description:
https://www.savethechildren.org.uk/christmas-jumper-day/about/Shaun-the-Sheep 
Shaun the Sheep reprises his role this holiday season as Save the Children’s Head of Wool for Christmas Jumper Day! 🐑🧶🎄 This year, Shaun is encouraging kids and adults everywhere to make the world better with a sweater. Aardman has colla-baa-rated with international children’s charity Save the Children on a new Shaun the Sheep animation to celebrate the charity’s Christmas Jumper Day fundraising campaign. As the woolliest day of the year approaches on Thursday 11th December, our favourite Mossy Bottom Farm residents are preparing for the big day. Watch as Shaun shows his co-knit-ment to Save the Children’s baa-rilliant cause, spreading festive cheer and encouraging everyone to donate along the way! Join the flock and support the campaign by signing up now: https://www.savethechildren.org.uk/christmas-jumper-day/about/Shaun-the-Sheep
